thread:
Nora (CSM): Heads-up: account 'Northforge' hit an unexpected token run during onboarding. QBR Friday. Need a 2-paragraph brief + 4 action bullets for the slide. Internal link: https://redwood.internal/northforge-onboard

Diego (AM): saw usage spike. Looks like embeddings + repeated batch similarity checks from the ingestion job. Pulling per-route token counts now.

budget-bot: ALERT: Account=Northforge projected to exceed monthly commit by 22% within 5d. Top contributors: embeddings 55%, similarity-rerank 28%, chat-gen 12%.

Priya (FinOps): Please paste a 14-day token SQL dump here so I can model dollar impact. Quick template: `SELECT route, SUM(tokens) AS tokens FROM usage WHERE account='northforge' AND ts > now() - interval '14 days' GROUP BY route ORDER BY tokens DESC;`

Jin (Solutions Eng): Quick hypotheses: 1) ingestion pipeline sending overlapping queries, 2) no prefix KV caching for deduped queries, 3) batch windows too large for embeddings. I can run a 2-hour staging experiment (enable KV cache, set embedding_batch_limit=128, enforce ingest_rate_limit=400 TPS). ETA ~3h for results.

Nora (CSM): Need customer-facing bullets: what we changed immediately, recommended next steps, owners + ETA. Keep it short.

Diego (AM): Draft bullets for the QBR slide:
- Immediate (now): throttled embedding ingestion to 400 TPS and paused the 1 large nightly batch (owner: Diego).
- Short-term (24-72h): enabled per-account prefix KV cache to collapse duplicate similarity queries (owner: Jin).
- Policy (this week): add budget webhook + 70% notification + weekly spend digest to the CS channel (owner: Priya).
- Next (post-QBR): 60-min enablement session on prompt shaping and dedupe patterns (owner: Nora).

Priya (FinOps): I'll attach projected $ and commit delta once Diego pastes token counts. Also recommending smart-routing fallback for background reranks to quantized model (saves ~33%).

Jin (Solutions Eng): Staging command I'll run:
```bash
curl -X POST https://dedicated.redwood/v1/accounts/northforge/config \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"kv_cache":true, "embedding_batch_limit":128, "ingest_rate_limit":400, "route_policy":"cost-aware"}'
```
I'll post token delta and latency impact after the 2h window.

Diego (AM): Pasted the 14d totals: embeddings=3,420,000 tokens; similarity-rerank=1,750,000 tokens; chat-gen=720,000 tokens. (quick calc attached).

Priya (FinOps): Thanks. Projected overage = ~22% -> est $4.1k above commit for this month if unchanged. With KV cache + quantized routing we estimate ~35-40% reduction on non-critical reranks -> saves ~$1.4k. I'll add a sensitivity table to the QBR slide.

Nora (CSM): Perfect. Who will present cost & mitigation at the QBR? @Diego or @Priya?

Diego (AM): I can present the mitigation plan and numbers; Priya can run through the dollar sensitivity. :+1:

budget-bot: NOTE: Created ticket #CS-10222 'Northforge onboarding spend triage' (owner: Diego).

Jin (Solutions Eng): Follow-ups I'll include in ticket: rollback criteria, safe test plan, expected latency delta, and a 48h monitoring checklist (error rates, 95p latency, tokens/day).

Priya (FinOps): Also recommend we set a temporary hard cap at 120% of commit to prevent surprise overages during onboarding. We can lift after review. Owner: Priya.

Nora (CSM): Great — I'll add these bullets + owners to the QBR deck and share a one-pager with the customer ahead of the call. Thanks everyone.
